messages:
maya: Heads-up from AE: a handful of customers asked for a concept were calling 'emergency buffer' for dedicated pools. They want predictable baseline plus a controlled spike above it for short incidents.

eli: quick clarify: is buffer prepaid or borrow-from-next-period?

maya: Sales prefers borrow-from-next-period (easier to sell), but ops is wary. They asked for clear repayment and preemption rules.

sam: ops concerns: fairness & billing complexity. if many tenants borrow we need admission rules that avoid cascading preempts. Proposal: a per-tenant borrow limit and a global soft cap that triggers spillover.

toni: product suggestion: two modes: "borrowable" (deducts from next period, auto-repay X%/day) and "prepaid-burst" (one-time top-up). Default to borrowable for enterprise customers only.

eli: eng notes: runtime changes needed: add fields to tenant config (borrow_mode, borrow_balance, repay_rate, borrow_cap). Admission controller needs to subtract borrow_balance from effective quota. Also prioritized eviction when borrower_count_above_threshold.

maya: Sales ask for CSV billing fields: tenant_id, committed_units, baseline_used, burst_used, borrow_balance, repay_rate, borrow_mode, billing_period.

sam: ops: monitoring -> add alerts when global borrowed_sum > 60% of global reserved headroom; per-tenant alert when borrow_balance > 40% of borrow_cap and when repayment_derivative negative for 24h.

toni: UX: in console show a timeline widget: current borrowed, projected repayment in days, and a 'request emergency top-up' CTA that routes to sales.

eli: rough estimate: admission controller + billing CSV + console + telemetry = 2 engs x 4 sprints to be safe. Could be trimmed to 3 sprints if we prototype with limited console.

maya: prioritization proposal: MVP = enterprise borrowable (cap 25% committed, repay 15%/day), ops-only staging dry-run, billing CSV + export. GA after 2 customer pilots.

sam: ops gating: require staging dry-run and resilience test where 30% of tenants simulate max borrow for 48h. Also need a runbook for forced repayment / emergency rollback.

toni: agree on messaging: call it 'Commitment Buffer' in docs, but internal name 'borrowable buffer'. docs snippet for AE decks?

maya: sample CSV line for decks: tenant_987,2000000,150000,30000,25000,15%/day,borrowable,2024-12

infra-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance window 2024-12-03 02:00-03:00 UTC (tag: roadmap-commitment-buffer)

eli: next steps: mara (ops) and eng pair to design admission rule edge cases; maya will collect 3 customer scenarios; toni will mock console card; schedule 30m sync Wed.

maya: I'll follow up with a short one-pager + sales-friendly FAQ before Wed.
